prompt_fragment:
This asset is an icon. Use crisp, reduced shapes, bold edges, and high readability at very small sizes.
Keep the icon silhouette bold, crisp, and readable at 16px.
raw_description:
A stylized sanctuary / ceremonial settlement. Flat app-icon geometry.
One tall single spire rising from a simple base block — slender
vertical triangular shape, taller than wide. Topped with a simple
geometric ornament: a circular ring or a diamond-shaped crystal in
a contrasting luminous palette color (cyan, aurora-green, or gold).
Solemn / ceremonial feel, not defensive or industrial.
formatted_prompt: Flat app-icon illustration, crisp vector geometry, centered on a clean off-white canvas with generous padding. A single tall slender spire rising from a low rectangular base block — the spire a sharp vertical triangle, taller than wide, filled in vivid primary red (#FF0000), the base block filled in bold primary blue (#0000FF). Atop the spire, a small geometric diamond-crystal ornament filled in bright primary yellow (#FFFF00), sharply defined, small and precise. All edges razor-crisp, no gradients, no textures, no brushwork. Flat bold fills throughout, strong color separation between red spire, blue base, and yellow crown. Solemn vertical silhouette, ceremonial not defensive. Readable at 16px.
